seo.title: Funafuti homeless help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified shelter, food, health, safety, legal and social support for people experiencing homelessness in Funafuti.

page.heading: FUNAFUTI - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger or medical emergency: 911 or 999. Princess Margaret Hospital is Tuvalu's only hospital.
page.notice: Information and availability can change. Call before travelling when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, treatment or job.
page.intro: No general walk-in homeless shelter is publicly listed in Funafuti. Contact the Social Welfare Department, Gender Affairs Department, police or Tuvalu Red Cross for assessment and referrals. People escaping domestic violence may be able to receive emergency financial and protection support, but availability must be confirmed locally.
page.footer: Main sources: Tuvalu Ministry of Health and Social Welfare, Social Welfare and Gender Affairs departments, Tuvalu Red Cross Society, Tuvalu Family Health Association and the People's Lawyer.

entries.title: Princess Margaret Hospital
entries.description: Tuvalu's only hospital, providing emergency and routine medical care in Funafuti.
entries.how_to_access: Call 911 or 999 for an ambulance, or attend the hospital.

entries.title: Tuvalu Red Cross Society
entries.description: Humanitarian, health and disaster assistance through the national society. Support depends on assessment and current programmes.
entries.how_to_access: Call and explain the need. Use emergency services for immediate danger.

entries.title: Tuvalu Red Cross Society
entries.description: Community humanitarian, health and disaster support. It is not a guaranteed daily shelter or food programme.

entries.title: Princess Margaret Hospital
entries.description: Main public hospital for Funafuti and referral centre for Tuvalu's outer islands.
entries.how_to_access: Attend the hospital for urgent care or call 911 or 999.

entries.title: Tuvalu Family Health Association
entries.description: Sexual and reproductive health information, counselling and support.
entries.how_to_access: Contact the association for current clinic and counselling details.

entries.title: Social Welfare Department
entries.description: Government psychosocial support, counselling and social-welfare referrals. The department works with Gender Affairs, police, health services and community organisations.
entries.how_to_access: Visit the Ministry responsible for health and social welfare and ask for the Social Welfare Department.

entries.title: People's Lawyer Office
entries.description: Public legal assistance, including referrals connected with domestic violence and protection matters.
entries.how_to_access: Ask at the government offices for the People's Lawyer intake process.

entries.title: Gender Affairs and Social Welfare support
entries.description: Government counselling, protection referrals and emergency financial support may be available to survivors of domestic violence through the Domestic Violence Fund.
entries.how_to_access: Contact Gender Affairs, Social Welfare or police. Use 911 or 999 if there is immediate danger.

entries.title: Fusi Alofa
entries.description: Community support and rehabilitation for people with disabilities and their families in Tuvalu.
entries.how_to_access: Ask Social Welfare or Tuvalu Red Cross for current contact details and referral.
